senses.gloss:
प्रव प्रव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. प्रु), Ved.
fluttering, hovering; (Sāy.) = गच्छत्.
—प्रव-ग,
अस्, m. = प्लव-ग, a monkey.
—प्रवङ्-ग, अस्,
m. = प्लवङ्-ग, a monkey; (आस्), m. pl., N. of
a people.
—प्रवङ्-गम, अस्, m. = प्लवङ्-गम,
a monkey.

प्रवा 1. प्र-वा, cl. 2. P. -वाति, -वातुम्, to
blow forth, blow violently, blow; to smell, yield a
scent: Caus. -वापयति, -यितुम्, to dry up, dry.

2. प्र-वा (आस्?), f., Ved. blowing, blowing away,
(प्र-वा उप-वा, blowing to and fro); N. of a
daughter of Dakṣa.
प्रवक, अस्, आ, अम्, going, one who goes.

प्र-वाक, अस्, m. proclaiming, announcing, a pro-
claimer, announcer.

प्रवाक प्र-वाक, प्र-वाच्, &c. See p. 641,
col. 3.

प्रवच् प्र-वच्, cl. 2. P. -वक्ति, -वक्तुम्, to
speak forth, begin to speak, declare, announce, relate,
tell (with acc. of the thing and gen. or dat. of the
person); to speak to, address; to speak, say; to
explain; to recite; to celebrate.

प्र-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, eloquent, oratorical, speaking,
a speaker.

प्र-वक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be declared or
announced; to be imparted or taught; to be ex-
pounded or explained.

प्र-वक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who speaks or de-
clares, one who announces or informs, a speaker,
declarer, announcer, informer; a propounder, teacher,
expounder (Manu VII. 20); a fine speaker, good
orator, eloquent man.
—प्रवक्तृ-त्व, अम्, n. the
being an expounder or teacher.

प्र-वचन, अम्, n. speaking, talking; declara-
tion, announcement, proclamation; recitation, oral
instruction, teaching, expounding, exposition, inter-
pretation [cf. साङ्ख्य-प्रवचन-भाष्य]; ex-
cellent speech or language, eloquence; an expression,
[]
term; a system of doctrines propounded in a treatise
or dissertation; sacred writings, especially the Brāh-
maṇas; the fundamental doctrine of Buddhists; the
sacred writings of the Jainas; प्र-वचन is also
said to be used as an enclitic after a simple verb, see
Gaṇa Gotrādi to Pāṇ. VIII. 1, 27.
—प्रवचन-
पटु, उस्, उस्, उ, skilled in speaking, eloquent.

प्र-वचनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be declared; to be
taught or propounded; to be well or elegantly
spoken; a good speaker; a propounder, teacher.

प्र-वाचक, अस्, इका, अम्, declaratory, explana-
tory; speaking well, eloquent.

प्र-वाच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be proclaimed aloud;
praiseworthy, glorious (Ved., Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण
वक्तव्य); to be spoken to or addressed; (अम्),
n. a literary production.

प्रवट प्र-वट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वट् with प्र),
wheat.

प्रावट प्रावट, अस्, m. barley; [cf. प्र-वट,
प्र-वेट.]

प्रवण प्रवण, अम्, n. (probably fr. 1. प्र;
but according to Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 5, said to be fr. 1.
प्र + वन, a forest), the side of a hill, a declivity,
steep descent, precipice, an abyss, depth, (in the
earlier language used only in loc. sing.; Sāy. =
निम्न-प्रदेश); (अस्), m. a place where four
roads meet; (ए), ind. in a precipitous course, pre-
cipitously, precipitately, suddenly, hurriedly, hastily;
(अस्, आ, अम्), declining, bent, bowed, sloping down,
shelving, flowing down (often in comps., e. g. निम्न-
प्˚, flowing downwards; cf. उदक्-प्˚, दक्षिणा-प्˚);
precipitous, inclining downwards, steep, abrupt;
curved, crooked; inclining, inclined to, directed
towards, disposed to, tending to [cf. वञ्चन-प्˚];
ready, willing; applying one's self to, devoted to,
attached or adhering to, addicted, prone [cf. वि-
षय-प्˚]; filled with, possessed of, endowed with;
generous; humble, modest; waning or fading away,
wasted, decayed, disappeared.
—प्रवण-ता, f. pre-
cipitousness, inclination, proclivity, propensity, pro-
pension, attachment, devotion.
—प्रवण-प्रहर्-
ष, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose joy has faded away, whose
happiness has disappeared.
—प्रवण-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, having a steep descent or declivity, having a
downward course, downward, precipitous.

प्रवाण प्र-वाण, प्र-वाणि. See under
प्र-वे, p. 645, col. 1.

प्र-वाण, अम्, n. the edging or trimming of a
piece of woven cloth.

प्रवणाय, Nom. P. प्रवणायति, -यितुम्, to
feel inclined or disposed towards.
प्रवणायित, अम्, n. inclination, propensity, bias.

प्रवत्, त्, f. (fr. 1. प्र), Ved. the side of a moun-
tain, a declivity, precipice; an elevation, height, the
heavenly height; a sloping path, easy course, rapid pro-
gress; प्रवतो नपात्, ‘son of the heavenly height,’
an epithet of lightning; प्रवतस्, pl. the heavenly
heights (sometimes said to be three, sometimes
seven in number; Sāy. = आपस्); flowing down
declivities (said of rivers; Sāy. = प्रवण-देशे गच्-
छत्); (आन्, अती, अत्), directed forwards or towards;
containing the syllable प्र or पृ; (in the preceding
adj. senses fr. 1. प्र + वत्); प्रवता or प्रवद्भिः,
ind. down hill, downwards (Sāy. = प्रवणवता
मार्गेण); precipitately, rapidly, swiftly.
—प्रवत्-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having a downward course, de-
scending; precipitous, headlong, rapid; affording a
downward path, suited for rapid motion; hilly.
—प्र-
वद्-भार्गव, N. of a Sāman.
—प्रवद्-यामन्,
आ, m., Ved. having a downward path, rapid in its
course (as a chariot; Sāy. = शीघ्र-गामिन्).
प्रवत्स्यत् प्र-वत्स्यत्. See 2. प्र-वस्, p. 642.

प्र-वत्स्यत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, about to dwell
[]
abroad.
—प्रवत्स्यत्-पतिका, f. the wife of a man
who intends to make a journey.

प्रवद् प्र-वद्, cl. 1. P. A. -वदति, -ते,
-वदितुम्, to speak forth, speak out, pronounce,
utter; to proclaim, declare; to speak to, address; to
say, speak, tell; to converse with; to explain: Caus.
-वादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to speak or sound forth,
to play (a musical instrument).

प्र-वद, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sounding forth, sound-
ing (as a drum).

प्र-वाद, अस्, m. speaking forth, uttering a word
or sound; expressing, naming, mentioning; declar-
ing, declaration [cf. वेद-प्˚]; discourse, conversa-
tion; a saying, popular talk, rumour, report; spread-
ing a report, (द्यूत-प्˚, report of gambling); a
fable, myth; mutual defiance, the conversation of
antagonists prior to combat; litigious language; (in
Ved. gram.) a base or crude form (opposed to a
word with a case termination &c.); (आ), f., Ved. in
गन्ध-प्रवादास्, f. pl. all that is called perfume (?) .

प्रवाद प्र-वाद, प्र-वादक, प्र-वादिन्.
See col. 1.

प्र-वदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, speaking forth, speaking
to or with, conversing, addressing; speaking much
or well; arguing, a disputant.

प्र-वदन, अम्, n., Ved. a proclamation, an-
nouncement.

प्र-वदितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who speaks
forth or speaks out, speaking out.

प्र-वादक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing to sound forth,
playing on (a musical instrument).

प्र-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, giving forth a sound, uttering
a cry; speaking, speaking of, reporting; (in Ved.
gram.) being in the crude form.

प्र-वाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be said or spoken; to
be proclaimed.

प्रवध्य प्र-वध्य, ind. (fr. rt. वध् with
प्र), having killed or slain.

प्रवन्द् प्र-वन्द्, cl. 1. A. -वन्दते, -वन्-
दितुम्, Ved. to praise highly, extol.

प्रवप् प्र-वप्, cl. 1. P. A. -वपति, -ते,
-वप्तुम्, to scatter forth, scatter, strew; to throw,
cast, shoot.

प्र-वप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र + वपा), having
much fat, very fat.

प्र-वपण, अम्, n., Ved. scattering forth, sow-
ing; shaving off (of the beard &c.).

प्र-वापयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who scatters
forth or pours out, scattering forth, pouring out.

प्रवापयितृ प्र-वापयितृ, प्र-वापिन्. See
under प्र-वप्, col. 1.

प्र-वापिन्, ई, इणी, इ, one who sows seed, sowing,
a sower.

प्रवयण 1. प्र-वयण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. वी =
rt. अज्; for 2. see under प्र-वे, p. 645, col. 1),
a goad; [cf. प्राजन.]

2. प्र-वयण, अम्, n. (for 1. see p. 642, col. 1),
the upper part of a piece of woven cloth.
प्र-वयणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be driven forwards (?) .

प्रवय्या, f., Ved. (a cow) to be driven on with
a goad (?) .

प्र-वाय्य, अम्, n., Ved. (perhaps) fleetness,
rapidity.
प्रवाय्य प्र-वाय्य. See 1. प्र-वा above.

प्रवयस् प्र-वयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, (Ved.) strong,
vigorous, in the prime of life; advanced in age, aged,
ancient; (Sāy.) = प्रवृद्धान्न or पुरातन.
प्रवर प्र-वर. See प्र-वृ, p. 644, col. 1.

प्र-वर, अस्, m. a call, summons (especially of
a Brāhman to priestly functions); an invocation ad-
dressed by a Brāhman at the consecration of his own
fire to Agni Havya-vāhana (in such invocations Agni
is invited to bear the oblations to the gods as he
did for the sacrificer's ancestors, and the names of
the first four or five of these ancestors, who are
most nearly connected with the ancient Ṛṣis, must
then be added to each invocation of Agni, thus
Gotama invokes Agni Āṅgirasa, Agni Āyāsya, Agni
Gautama, &c.); a line of ancestors (so named in
the preceding invocation to Agni); one of the forty-
nine Gotras, as opposed to the eight original Gotras;
a member of a line of ancestors, an ancestor; a
Muni who contributes to the credit of a particular
Gotra or family; family, race, lineage, kindred;
offspring, descendants; a covering, cover, screen; an
upper garment; a black variety of Phaseolus Mungo,
Oppuntia Dillenii; N. of a messenger of the gods
and friend of Indra; of a Dānava; (आ), f., N. of
a river which falls into the Go-dāvarī near Tokā,
and is celebrated for the sweetness of its water;
(अम्), n. aloe wood; a particular high number; (अस्,
आ, अम्), most excellent, chief, principal, best [cf.
शङ्ख-प्˚]; prominent, distinguished, exalted, emi-
nent; better, greater (e. g. ततः प्रवरः, better
or greater than that); eldest (e. g. पुत्र-प्रवर,
the eldest son; in some of the preceding adj. senses
perhaps fr. प्र + वर).
—प्रवर-दीपिका, f., N.
of a work.
—प्रवर-धातु, उस्, m., Ved. a
precious metal.
—प्रवर-भूपति, इस्, m. = प्र-
वर-सेन.
—प्रवर-मञ्जरी, f., N. of a work by
Puruṣottama.
—प्रवर-मूर्धज, अस्, m. excellent
hair (of the head).
—प्रवर-ललित, अम्, n. a kind
of metre, four times ˘¯¯¯¯¯˘˘˘˘˘¯¯˘¯¯.
—प्रवर-वाहन, औ, m. du. ‘having the best
of horses,’ an epithet of the Aśvins.
—प्रवर-
सेन, अस्, m., N. of two princes of Kaśmīra, one of
whom is also called Śreṣṭha-sena.
—प्रवरा-
ध्याय (˚र-अध्˚), अस्, m. ‘book of ancestral
lines,’ N. of the eleventh of the eighteen Pari-śiṣṭas
belonging to the White Yajur-veda.
—प्रवरेश
(˚र-ईश), अस्, m. a distinguished nobleman (?); =
प्रवर-सेन.
—प्रवरेश्वर (˚र-ईश्˚), अस्, m.,
N. of a temple built by Pravara-sena.
प्रवार प्र-वार, &c. See प्र-वृ, p. 644.

प्र-वार, अस्, m. a covering, cover, clothing,
woollen cloth.
प्रावर प्रा-वर. See under प्रा-वृ, p. 660.

प्रा-वर, अस्, m. an inclosure, a fence, hedge;
[cf. मही-प्˚.]
प्रावार प्रा-वार, &c. See under प्रा-वृ.

प्रा-वार, अस्, m. an upper or outer garment,
cloak, mantle; (अस्), m. = प्रा-वरक, N. of a
district; (अस्, आ, अम्), belonging to, found in outer
garments or cloaks.
—प्रावार-कर्ण, अस्, m.
‘cloak-eared,’ N. of an owl.
—प्रावार-कीट, अस्,
m. ‘clothes-insect,’ a large kind of white ant.

प्रवर्ग प्र-वर्ग, प्र-वर्ग्य, प्र-वर्जन.
See under प्र-वृज्, p. 644, col. 2.

प्र-वर्ग, अस्, m. sacrificial fire (= महा-वीर);
an excellent assemblage [cf. दास-प्˚]; (perhaps a
wrong reading for प्र-वर्ग्य.)
—प्रवर्गावर्त-
भूषण (˚ग-आव्˚), अस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.

प्रावर्ग प्रावर्ग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वर्ग),
Ved. distinguished, eminent; (Sāy.) pre-eminently a
scatterer of enemies (= प्रकर्षेण शत्रूणां
वर्जयिता).
प्रवर्त प्र-वर्त, &c. See 1. प्र-वृत्, p. 644.

प्र-वर्त, अस्, m. engaging in, undertaking; ex-
citement, stimulus; (Ved.) a round ornament.

प्रवर्धक प्र-वर्धक, प्र-वर्धन. See
under प्र-वृध्, p. 644, col. 3.

प्र-वर्धक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing to grow,
increasing, enhancing.

प्रवर्ष प्र-वर्ष, प्र-वर्षण, प्र-वर्-
षिन्. See under प्र-वृष्, p. 645, col. 1.
प्र-वर्ष, अस्, m. raining fast, rain.
प्रवर्ह प्र-वर्ह. See प्र-वृह्, p. 645, col. 1.
प्र-वर्ह, अस्, आ, अम्, chief, principal, first.

प्रवलाकिन् प्रवलाकिन्, ई, m. a peacock;
a snake; (incorrectly for प्रचलाकिन्.)

प्रवल्ह प्र-वल्ह, अस्, m., Ved. a riddle,
enigma.

प्रवल्हिका, f., Ved. a riddle, enigma; N. of the
formulas Atharva-veda XX. 133; [cf. प्रवह्लिका.]

प्रवस् 1. प्र-वस् (see rt. 5. वस्), cl. 2. A.
-वस्ते, -वसितुम्, to put on (clothes), to dress.

प्रवस् 2. प्र-वस् (see rt. 6. वस्), cl. 1. P.
-वसति, -वस्तुम्, to live afar off, dwell abroad; to
order to live abroad, banish to (with loc.): Caus.
-वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to live afar off, order to
dwell abroad, banish, exile.

प्र-वसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, dwelling or residing
abroad.

प्र-वासत् (?) , अन्, अन्ती, अत् (see प्र-वसत् above),
dwelling abroad, being absent from home.

प्र-वसथ, अम्, n., Ved. going abroad, de-
parting.

प्र-वसन, अम्, n. going abroad, setting out on a
journey, departing; sojourning in a foreign country.

प्र-वासन, अम्, n. causing to live abroad, send-
ing away from home, exile, banishment; dwelling
abroad, sojourning, lodging; killing, slaying.

प्र-वस्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be gone abroad,
to be departed.

प्र-वास, अस्, m. sojourning abroad, foreign resi-
dence, being away from home, being abroad; a tem-
porary sojourn; (in astronomy) heliacal setting of
the planets; प्रवासं गम्, to go abroad.
—प्र-
वास-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone abroad, gone away from
home.
—प्रवास-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, addicted to
living abroad or away from home.
—प्रवास-स्थ
or प्रवास-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelling abroad, being
absent from home.
प्रवास प्र-वास, &c. See col. 2.

प्रावास प्रावास, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वास),
see Gaṇa Vyuṣṭādi to Pāṇ. V. 1, 97.

प्र-वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to dwell abroad,
banished, exiled, expatriated, expelled.

प्र-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dwelling or residing abroad,
being or living away from home; being on a journey,
a traveller, sojourner; परलोक-नव-प्रवासिन्,
one who has lately set out for the next world.

प्र-वास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to live abroad,
to be sent into exile, to be banished.

प्रवसु प्र-वसु, उस्, m., N. of a son of
Īlina.

प्रवह् प्र-वह्, cl. 1. P. -वहति, -वोढुम्,
to carry forwards, drag onwards, draw; to carry forth,
carry off; to breathe.

प्र-वह, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing forwards, carrying
off, bearing away; (अस्), m. ‘bearing forwards,’ N. of
one of the seven winds said to cause the motion of
the planets; wind, air; N. of one of the seven
tongues of Fire; a reservoir into which water is
carried off [cf. वर्षाम्बु-प्˚]; flowing or stream-
ing forth; going forth, going from a town; [cf.
प्र-वाह below.]

प्र-वाह, अस्, m. a stream, current, flow, flux,
course; running water; continuous flow or passage;
unbroken succession, continuity; flowing or streaming
forth [cf. प्र-वह above]; course or direction
towards; anything moving onwards like a current,
current of human affairs &c., course of action, active
life, occupation; a pond; N. of one of the attendants
of Skanda; a beautiful or swift horse; (ई), f. sand.
—प्रवाहे-मूत्रित, अम्, n. ‘making water in a
river,’ a metaphorical expression for a useless action.
प्रवाह प्र-वाह, &c. See col. 2.

प्र-वहण, अम्, n. a covered carriage, a litter
or carriage for women; a ship; (अस्), m., N. of a
Dānava.

प्र-वाहण, अस्, ई, अम्, carrying off, carrying
away (Ved.); (अस्), m., N. of a man (Ved.); (ई), f.
the sphincter muscle which ejects the feces from the
rectum; (अम्), n. driving forth; evacuation by stool
(especially if from sudden desire).

प्र-वहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, carrying forwards, bear-
ing; breathing; receiving, enjoying (?).

प्र-वाहक, अस्, इका, अम्, carrying forwards, car-
rying off, bearing or carrying well; (अस्), m. a
Rākṣasa, an imp, goblin; (इका), f. a sudden desire
to evacuate, diarrhœa; (आ), ind. = प्र-बाहुक्, q. v.,
see Gaṇa Svar-ādi to Pāṇ. I. 1, 37.

प्रवाहणेय, अस्, or प्रवाहणेयि, इस्, m. a
patronymic from Pravāhaṇa.

प्रावाहणेय, अस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-
vāhaṇa.

प्रवाहणेयक, अस्, इका, अम्, see Scholiast on
Pāṇ. VII. 3, 29.

प्रावाहणेयक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. प्रावाहणेय),
= प्रवाहणेयक.

प्र-वाहिन्, ई, इणी, or इनी, इ, carrying forwards,
drawing; carrying off, carrying away (said of a river);
flowing, streaming [cf. लोक-प्˚]; (इणी or इनी), f. a
region abounding in streams (?) .

प्रवाह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fluviatic, fluvial;
(Mahī-dhara = स्रोतसि भवः.)

शयन, अम्, n. a bed placed in the middle of a

बाल, q. v.

प्रवायक प्र-वायक. See Scholiast on

disappeared.

प्र-विगाह्य, ind. having dived into, having
entered.

or breaking up the Sandhi.

प्रविचक्ष् प्र-वि-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे (see

vance; to rove about, roam about; to go through,
walk through, roam or wander through: Caus.
-चारयति, -यितुम्, to examine or investigate accu-
rately.

प्र-विचरन्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going forwards, mov-
ing onwards; going through, roaming through.
प्र-विचार, अस्, m. discernment, discrimination.

प्र-विचारित, अस्, आ, अम्, examined or investi-
gated accurately.

प्रविचल् प्र-वि-चल्, cl. 1. P. -चलति, -चलि-
तुम्, to move about, shake, quake, tremble; to go
astray, deviate; to become confused, be thrown into
confusion: Caus. -चालयति, -यितुम्, to set in motion,
cause to tremble, shake.

प्र-विचलित, अस्, आ, अम्, set in motion, moved,
shaking, quaking.

प्रविचि प्र-वि-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -चि-
नुते, -चेतुम्, to search through, investigate, examine,
test, prove.
प्र-विचय, अस्, m. investigation, examination.

प्रविचिन्त् प्र-वि-चिन्त्, cl. 10. P. -चिन्तयति,
-यितुम्, to think about, reflect upon.

प्र-विचिन्तक, अस्, इका, अम्, reflecting before-
hand, foreseeing.

प्र-विचिन्त्य, ind. having thought about or re-
flected upon.

प्रविचेतन प्र-विचेतन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 4.
चित् with प्र), comprehending, understanding.

प्रविजय प्र-विजय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a
people.

जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to know severally or in detail,
know accurately.

प्रवितन् प्र-वि-तन्, cl. 8. P. A. -तनोति,
-तनुते, -तनितुम्, to stretch forwards, spread out,
extend; to begin a sacred rite; to commence.

प्र-वितत, अस्, आ, अम्, stretched forwards, spread
out, expanded; dishevelled.

प्रवितप् प्र-वि-तप्, cl. 1. P. -तपति, -तप्-
तुम्, to scorch up, pain with heat.

प्र-वितप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, scorched up, pained
with heat.

प्रविद् 1. प्र-विद्, Caus. -वेदयति, -यितुम्,
to make known; to possess knowledge or wisdom,

2. प्र-विद्, त्, f. making known, proclaiming, pro-
clamation (Sāy. = प्र-वेदन).

प्र-विद्वस्, वान्, उषी, वत्, very knowing,
wise (?) .

प्र-वेद, अस्, m. in अ-प्˚, q. v.

प्र-वेदन, अम्, n. the act of making known,
proclaiming, announcing.

प्र-वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, knowing accurately, well
acquainted with.
प्र-वेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made known.

burst asunder, bursting, tearing, rending, breaking;
budding; conflict, war, battle, combat; tumult,
crowd, confusion.

प्र-विदारित, अस्, आ, अम्, torn, rent, severed;
opened, expanded.
प्रविद्ध प्र-विद्ध. See प्र-व्यध्, p. 645.
प्र-विद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown away, cast away.

प्रविद्रु प्र-वि-द्रु, cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रो-
तुम्, to run or rush apart, disperse, retreat.

प्र-विद्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, running apart, dispersed,
scattered.

tate or think upon; to place in front, put at the
head, pay attention to.

प्र-विधाय, ind. having placed in front, having
paid attention to.

प्रविध्वस्त प्र-विध्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown
away; tossed about, agitated.

प्रविनश् प्र-वि-नश्, cl. 4. P. (ep. also A.)
-नश्यति (-ते), -नशितुम्, -नंष्टुम्, to perish
utterly, be destroyed.

प्रविपल प्र-विपल, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?) ,
a particular minute division of time, a small part of a
Vipala.

प्रविभज् प्र-वि-भज्, cl. 1. P. A. -भजति,
-ते, -भक्तुम्, to part asunder, sever, sunder, sepa-
rate; to divide, distribute, apportion.

प्र-विभक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, parted asunder, severed,
sundered, separated; divided, distributed, partitioned,
apportioned, shared; variously situated.
—प्रवि-
भक्त-रश्मि, इस्, इस्, इ, having the rays distributed,
distributing rays.

प्र-विभज्य, ind. having parted asunder, having
separated; having divided or apportioned.

प्र-विभाग, अस्, m. parting asunder, division,
separation, distribution, classification; a part, portion.
—प्रविभाग-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having subdivisions,
subdivided.
—प्रविभाग-शस्, ind. according to
the several portions or divisions.

प्रविभिन्न प्र-विभिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken
or torn off, wounded.

प्रविभुज् प्र-वि-भुज्, cl. 6. P. -भुजति,
-भोक्तुम्, to bow.

प्रविमुच् प्र-वि-मुच्, cl. 6. P. A. -मुञ्चति,
-ते, -मोक्तुम्, to set free, release, liberate; to lay
aside, relinquish, resign, abandon: Pass. -मुच्यते,
to be freed from, be rid of (with abl.).

प्रविमृश् प्र-वि-मृश्, cl. 6. P. -मृशति,
-मर्ष्टुम्, -म्रष्टुम्, to think upon, meditate,
ponder, reflect, deliberate.

प्र-विमृश्य, ind. having thought upon, having
pondered or considered.

प्रविर प्रविर, अस्, m. a species of fragrant
wood, yellow sandal.

प्रवीर प्र-वीर, अस्, आ, अम्, heroic, strong,
powerful; best, most excellent; (अस्), m. a hero,
warrior, chief, prince, a person of rank or distinction;
N. of a son of Pūru; of a son of Pra-cinvat and
grandson of Pūru; of a son of Dharma-netra; of a
son of Hary-aśva; of a son of the fourteenth Manu;
of a Caṇḍāla; (आस्), m. pl., N. of the descendants
of Pravīra (son of Pūru).
—प्रवीर-बाहु, उस्, m.
‘strong-armed,’ N. of a Rākṣasa.
—प्रवीर-वर,
अस्, m. ‘best of heroes,’ N. of an Asura.

प्रविरल प्र-विरल, अस्, आ, अम्, separated by
a considerable interval, separate, isolated, few, very
rare, very scanty.

लम्ब् with प्र-वि), hanging forwards, projecting,
prominent.
प्रविलय प्र-विलय. See प्र-वि-ली below.

प्र-विलय, अस्, m. becoming dissolved, melting
away; complete dissolution or absorption.

probably fr. प्र + विल with सेना), N. of a prince.

with प्र-वि), grieving, sorrowing, lamenting.

लातुम्, to become dissolved, melt away; to vanish
away, disappear, fade away.

with प्र-वि), cut away, removed, lost, fallen or
rubbed off.

प्र-विलोकयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, looking forwards,
looking about.

Ved. to blow asunder, disperse, scatter; (Sāy.) =
नितरां गमय.

प्रविवाद प्र-विवाद (?) , अस्, m. altercation,
dispute (= वि-वाद).

प्रविविक्त प्र-विविक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. विच्
with प्र-वि), separated, detached; solitary.
प्र-विवेक, अस्, m. probably = वि-वेक, q. v.

into exile, desirous of banishing.

शति (-ते), -वेष्टुम्, to enter into, enter, come

appear: Caus. -वेशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to enter
into, allow to enter, bring into, introduce to (with
double acc.); to lead into (one's home), lead (home,
as a wife); to lay up, store up: Desid. -विविक्षति,
to wish to enter into.

प्र-विविक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to enter into,
being about to go into.
प्र-विशत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, entering.
प्र-विश्य, ind. having entered.

gone into, come into; entered upon, engaged in,
occupied with, begun, commenced; (आ), f., N. of
the mother of Paippalādi and Kauśika.

प्रविष्ट प्र-विष्ट, प्रविष्टक. See under
प्र-विश्, p. 643, col. 3.

प्रविष्टक, अम्, n. entering a room; entrance
on the stage.

ingress, penetrating, penetration; the entrance or door
of a house, &c.; the entrance of the sun into a sign of
the zodiac; entrance on the stage; coming on, setting
in (of night); going into, being contained in; income,
revenue; intentness on an object, engaging closely in
a pursuit or purpose; the syringe of a clyster-pipe;
प्रवेशं कृ, to make one's entrance, enter.
प्रवेश प्र-वेश, &c. See प्र-विश्, p. 643.

penetrating, one who enters; (at the end of comps.)
= प्र-वेश; (अस्), m. an interlude or introductory
scene acted by inferior characters for the purpose of
acquainting the audience with any events supposed
to have occurred between the two acts, a knowledge
of which is requisite for the understanding of what
follows; (according to Kāṭavema in the opening
scene in Śakuntalā, Act 2, the object of the Praveśaka,

together the story of the drama and the subdivisions
of the plot by concisely alluding to what has hap-
pened in the intervals of the acts, or what is likely
to happen at the end.)

प्र-वेशन, अम्, n. entering into, entering, en-
trance, going into; sexual intercourse; an entrance
to a house, principal door or gate; conducting into,
leading into, introducing.

शन), given on entering, to be done on entering,

a manufactory, workshop.

&c. (See also Gaṇa Anupravacanādi to Pāṇ. V.
1, 111.)

प्र-वेशयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made to enter,
to be led or conducted into.

enter, introduced, brought in, sent in.

प्र-वेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, entering; (at the end of an
adj. comp.) having an entrance.

pervaded; to be played (as a musical instrument);
to be led or conducted into, to be brought into; to
be placed in or upon.

ing sent or thrown in, having sent or thrown into.

penetrated or pervaded; to be caused or allowed to
enter, to be admitted.

प्र-वेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who enters or goes
into, entering, going in.

प्रविश्लेष प्र-विश्लेष, अस्, m. separation,
parting.

circumference, compass.

desire, love.
प्रावी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. attentive, taking care of.

skilful, clever, proficient, conversant with, skilled
in, versed in, an adept; (अस्), m., N. of a son of
the fourteenth Manu.

त्व, अम्, n. skill, proficiency.

तुम्, to cover; to defend; to present (?) .

-वृणोति, -वृणुते, -वृणाति, -वृणीते, -वरति, -ते,

(with acc.).

tion, opposition; (with Buddhists) the festivities at

प्˚]; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; चीर-प्रावरण,
आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

प्र-वारक, अस्, m. (with Buddhists) the festi-
vities at the end of the rainy season; (अम्), n. a

प्रा-वारक, अस्, m. an upper or outer garment,
cloak.

peded, undisputed (as dominion); round; (अस्), m.

a veil, mantle, cloak, wrapper.

प्रवृज् प्र-वृज्, cl. 2. A. -वृक्ते, -वर्जितुम्,
Ved. to purify; (Sāy.) = प्रकर्षेण छिद्, to cut
or strew in abundance; = प्र-भृ, q. v.

प्र-वर्ग्य, अस्, m. a ceremony introductory to
the Soma sacrifice, pouring fresh milk into a heated
vessel (called महा-वीर or घर्म), or according
to others into boiling ghee (Sāy. = तप्ते घृते
पयः-प्रक्षेपः).
—प्रवर्ग्य-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, Ved. connected with the Pravargya ceremony.
—प्रवर्ग्याभरण-भूषण (˚य-आभ्˚), अस्,
m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.

प्र-वर्जन, अम्, n. the performance of the
Pravargya ceremony, pouring fresh milk into a heated
vessel or into boiling ghee.
प्र-वृज्य = प्र-वर्ग्य.
प्र-वृञ्जन, अम्, n. = प्र-वर्जन.

प्रवृञ्जनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. used at the Pra-
vargya ceremony (said of the महा-वीर, q. v.).

प्रवृत् 1. प्र-वृत्, cl. 1. A. (also P. in Fut.,
Cond., and Aor.) -वर्तते, -वर्तितुम्, to go or roll
forwards, roll on, flow onwards, proceed, make
progress, go on well; to come forth, come into
being, arise, be produced; to become, exist; to
happen, take place, come to pass; to begin, com-
mence (with acc. or inf.); to engage in, enter upon,
be occupied in (with loc.); to behave, conduct one's
self; to hold good: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to proceed; to cause to flow onwards; to set
in motion or action, instigate, urge, excite; to throw,
cast; to produce, create; to devise, invent.
2. प्र-वृत्, त्, f., Ved. = प्र-वृत्ति.

प्र-वर्तक, अस्, इका, अम्, setting in motion or
action, setting on foot; advancing, promoting, forward-
ing; producing, causing, effecting, inducing, inciting,
prompting, instigating, stimulating, urging; (अस्), m.
the original instigator of any act, originator, author,
principal, founder; an arbiter, judge; (अम्), n. (in
dramatic language) the entrance of a character on
the stage.

प्रावर्तक प्रा-वर्तक, अस्, इका, अम् (for प्र-
वर्तक), bringing to light, manifesting; stirring
up, inciting; founding, a founder.

प्र-वर्तन, अम्, n. rolling forwards, revolving,
rolling on, flowing forwards, going or moving for-
wards, coming forth, walking, roaming, wandering;
activity, action, acting; applying one's self to, en-
gaging in, occupying one's self in, having dealings
with (with loc. or inst.); beginning, commencing;
behaviour, conduct, procedure, mode of living; hap-
pening, coming to pass, coming to light, appearing;
bringing forward, presenting (Ved.); pushing for-
ward, setting on foot, setting up, establishing, insti-
tuting, erecting [cf. महायन्त्र-प्˚]; instigating
to action; inciting, prompting, stimulating; directing,
superintending; employing, employment; exhorta-
tion; informing; (आ), f. inciting or stimulating to
action; ordering, the sense of the imperative or of
the precative tense (?).

प्र-वर्तनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be set in motion,
to be instigated; to be used or employed.

प्र-वर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, moving on, rolling
on, proceeding, going forth; engaging in, practising,
being occupied with, doing; being used or employed.

प्रवर्तमानक, अस्, m., Ved. a diminutive of
the preceding; (Sāy.) = अति-शीघ्रम् अभि-गच्छत्,
going forth hastily, hastening forth.

प्र-वर्तयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who sets in
motion or action, exciting activity, instigating to
action; establishing, erecting, a builder, founder;
applying or inflicting, one who applies or inflicts.

प्र-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to roll on or for-
wards, caused to turn, going round, revolving; set
in motion, set on foot; set up, established; stimu-
lated, excited, incited, instigated; lighted, kindled;
caused, made, rendered; informed, apprized; made
pure (= पवित्री-कृत, Manu XI. 196).

प्र-वर्तितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be proceeded, to
be acted, to be practised.

प्र-वर्तितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who causes or
effects; one who establishes or determines.

प्र-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, moving forwards, proceeding,
advancing, moving, flowing; coming forth, flowing
forth, streaming; being active; causing to flow;
setting in motion or action, causing, effecting, pro-
ducing; spreading, introducing; using, employing;
अ-प्रवर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, immovable, unchangeable,
unalterable, invariable.

प्र-वर्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be excited to activity,
to be instigated or stimulated.

प्रवृत्तक, अम्, n. the entrance of a character
on the stage (= प्र-वर्तक); a kind of metre.

प्र-वृत्ति, इस्, f. continuous flow onwards, pro-
gress, advance, advancement; success; coming forth,
appearing, appearance, manifestation; rise, source,
origin, beginning; activity, effort, employment, oc-
cupation; active life (as opposed to नि-वृत्ति, q. v.,
and to contemplative devotion, and defined as con-
sisting of the wish to act, knowledge of the means,
and accomplishment of the object); giving or apply-
ing one's self to, devoting one's self to (with loc.);
course or tendency towards, addiction to, inclination
or predilection for; application, use, employment;
continued application, perseverance; practice, conduct,
behaviour; currency, continuance, continuity, pre-
valence, permanence, endurance; the applicableness
or validity of a rule; fate, lot, destiny; news, tidings,
intelligence [cf. दुष्-प्˚]; cognition, (विषयवती
प्रवृत्तिः, a sensuous immediate cognition); the
juice that exudes from the temples of an elephant in
rut; N. of Avantī or Oujein or any holy place; (in
arithmetic) the multiplier.
—प्रवृत्ति-ज्ञ, अस्, m.
‘knowing the news,’ an emissary, agent, spy.
—प्र-
वृत्ति-निमित्त, अम्, n. the reason for the use of
any term in the particular significations which it
bears.
—प्रवृत्ति-पराङ्मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, dis-
inclined to give tidings.
—प्रवृत्ति-मार्ग, अस्, m.
active or worldly life, occupancy about the business
and pleasures of the world or with the rites and
works of religion.

प्रा-वृति, इस्, f. an inclosure, fence, hedge; spiritual
darkness, one of the four consequences of Māyā.

प्रवृध् प्र-वृध्, cl. 1. A. -वर्धते, -वर्-
धितुम्, to grow up, grow, increase.

प्र-वर्धन, अस्, ई, अम्, who or what causes to
grow or increase; (अम्), n. augmenting, increase.

प्र-वृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, grown up, full grown;
increased, expanded, enlarged, diffused, spread abroad,
dispersed; large; swollen (as a river); full, deep (as
a sigh); haughty, arrogant; violent.

प्र-वृद्धि, इस्, f. growth, increase [cf. सस्य-प्˚,
श्मश्रु-प्˚]; rising, rise, (अर्घस्य प्˚, rising of
[]
the price of anything); prosperity, increasing welfare,
rising in rank or reputation.
प्रवृश्च्य प्र-वृश्च्य. See प्र-व्रश्च्, col. 2.
प्र-वृश्च्य, ind. having lacerated, having wounded.

प्रवृष् प्र-वृष्, cl. 1. P. -वर्षति, -वर्-
षितुम्, to begin to rain, rain.

प्रावृष् प्रा-वृष्, ट्, f. (fr. प्र-वृष्), the
rainy season, wet season, rains; the months Āṣāḍha
and Śrāvaṇa (comprising the first half of the rainy
season which lasts in some parts from the middle of
June till the middle of October).
—प्रावृट्-काल,
अस्, m. the period of the rains, rainy season.
—प्रा-
वृट्काल-वह, अस्, आ, अम्, flowing only in the
rainy season; (opposed to सदाकाल-वह.)
—प्रा-
वृड्-अत्यय, अस्, m. the time following the rainy
season, autumn.
—प्रावृषि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced
in the rainy season, occurring during the rains.

प्र-वर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, raining, causing to rain,
showering, discharging; ऊर्ध्व-प्रवर्षिन्, ‘rain-
ing upwards,’ offering sacrifices.

प्रावर्षिन् प्रा-वर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. rt. वृष्
with प्र), Ved. raining.

प्रवृह् प्र-वृह्, cl. 6. P. A. -वृहति, -ते,
-वर्हितुम्, -वर्ढुम्, Ved. to tear forth, tear away,
tear off, tear out; to draw out, extract; to rescue;
to tear to pieces, destroy; (Sāy.) = प्र-क्षिप्, to
hurl, fling; (A.) to draw towards one's self, attract.
प्र-वाणि, इस् or ई, f. a weaver's shuttle.

प्रावणि प्रावणि, see Ujjvala-datta on
Uṇādi-sūtras II. 103.

प्रवेग प्र-वेग, अस्, m. great speed, rapi-
dity; [cf. शर-प्˚.]
प्रवेगित, अस्, आ, अम्, moving swiftly, rapid.

प्रवेट प्र-वेट, अस्, m. barley; [cf. प्र-वट,
प्रावट.]

प्रवेणि प्र-वेणि, इस् or ई, f. a braid of hair,
the hair twisted and unadorned (as worn by widows
and by wives in the absence of their husbands); a
piece of coloured woollen cloth (used instead of a
saddle); the housings of an elephant; (ई), f., N. of
a river.

प्रवेतृ प्र-वेतृ, ता, m. (fr. rt. वी with प्र),
a charioteer.

प्र-वेय, अस्, आ, अम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VI.
1, 83.

प्रवेप् प्र-वेप्, cl. 1. A. -वेपते, -वेपितुम्,
to tremble: Caus. -वेपयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
tremble, shake.
प्र-वेप, अस्, m. trembling, quivering.

प्रावेप प्रावेप, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वेप),
Ved. revolving easily, rolling easily, (Sāy. = कम्-
पन-शील.)

प्रवेपक, अस्, m. trembling, shivering, shud-
dering.
प्र-वेपथु, उस्, m. = प्रवेपक.

प्रवेपनिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. ‘causing (his enemies)
to tremble,’ an epithet of Indra.

प्र-वेपनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ.
VIII. 4, 34.
प्र-वेपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, trembling, shaking, tottering.

प्रवेरित प्रवेरित, अस्, आ, अम् (probably for
प्रावेरित fr. rt. ईर् with प्र-अव, but said by some
to be fr. प्र-आ-ईरित), thrown about, cast or hurled
hither and thither (= इतस्ततः पातित, Mahā-bh.
Svargārohaṇa-p. 47).

प्रवेल प्रवेल, अस्, m. a yellow variety of
kidney-bean, Phaseolus Mungo.

प्रवेष्ट् प्र-वेष्ट्, cl. 1. A. -वेष्टते, -वेष्टि-
तुम्, to cover over, cover, surround.

प्र-वेष्ट, अस्, m. an arm; the fore-arm or
wrist [cf. प्र-कोष्ठ]; the fleshy part of the
[]
back of an elephant on which the rider sits; an
elephant's housings; an elephant's gums.

प्र-वेष्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered over, covered,
surrounded.

प्रवेष्टक प्रवेष्टक, a various reading for
प्रविष्टक, q. v.

प्रव्यक्त प्र-व्यक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, evident, ap-
parent, manifest.
प्र-व्यक्ति, इस्, f. appearance, manifestation.

प्रव्यथ् प्र-व्यथ्, cl. 1. A. -व्यथते, -व्य-
थितुम्, to be afflicted or distressed; to be frightened,
fear, tremble at (with gen.).

प्र-व्यथित, अस्, आ, अम्, distressed, pained;
agitated, trembling.

प्रव्यध् प्र-व्यध्, cl. 4. P. -विध्यति, -व्यद्-
धुम्, to throw away, cast down.

प्र-व्याध, अस्, m., Ved. a bow-shot, the dis-
tance of the flight of an arrow.

प्र-व्याहार, अस्, m. (= प्रकृष्टोक्ति), pro-
longation or continuation of discourse.

प्रव्रज् प्र-व्रज्, cl. 1. P. -व्रजति, -व्रजितुम्,
to go forth, set out, travel forth, go abroad, go into
exile: Caus. -व्राजयति, -यितुम्, to send into exile,
banish.

प्र-व्राज्, ट्, m. a religious mendicant; [cf. परि-
व्राज्.]

प्र-व्रजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going forth, travelling
abroad.
प्र-व्रजन, अम्, n. going abroad, migrating.
प्र-व्राजन, अम्, n. banishing, banishment, exile.

प्र-व्रजिका, a wrong reading for प्र-व्रजिता or
प्र-व्राजिका.

प्र-व्रजित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone forth, gone away,
gone abroad, gone into exile; (अस्), m. a religious
mendicant, a mendicant or ascetic; the pupil or
attendant of a Jaina or Buddhist mendicant; (आ), f.
a female ascetic or devotee; spikenard, Nardostachys
Jatamansi; N. of another plant, = मुण्डीरी; (अम्),
n. the life of a religious mendicant.

प्र-व्रज्या, f. going abroad, migration, emigra-
tion; roaming, travelling, wandering about, espe-
cially as a religious mendicant (in a dress not
authorized by the Veda, Manu V. 89); the order
of a religious mendicant; retirement into solitude.
—प्रव्रज्यावसित (˚या-अव्˚), अस्, m. a religious
mendicant who renounces his order.

प्र-व्राज्य, ind. having sent into exile, having
banished.

प्राव्रज्य प्राव्रज्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-व्रज्या),
wandering as a religious mendicant.

प्राव्राज्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-व्राज्), the life of a
wandering religious mendicant; vagrancy.

प्र-व्राज, अस्, m., Ved. the bed of a river (Sāy.
= अत्यन्त-निम्नो देशो नद्याः).

प्र-व्राजक, अस्, m. a religious mendicant; (इका),
f. a female ascetic.
प्र-व्राजिन्, ई, m., Ved. a religious mendicant.

प्रव्रश्च् प्र-व्रश्च्, cl. 6. P. -वृश्चति, -व्रश्चि-
तुम्, -व्रष्टुम्, to tear to pieces, lacerate, wound.

प्र-व्रश्चन in इध्म-प्रव्रश्चन, अस्, m. an
instrument for cutting fuel, a knife for cutting wood.
प्र-व्रस्क, अस्, m., Ved. a cut.

प्रव्लय प्र-व्लय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. व्ली with
प्र), Ved. sinking down.

प्राव् प्राव् (प्र-अव्), cl. 1. P. प्रावति, प्रा-
वितुम्, Ved. to attend to, observe; to take interest
in, assist, encourage, animate; to protect, defend,
(Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण रक्ष्, to defend strenuously,
to protect exceedingly); to sate, satisfy, content.

प्रावितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. a protector, bene-
factor, guardian, (Sāy. = रक्षक.)
प्रावितृ प्रावितृ. See under प्राव्, p. 659.
प्रावित्र, अम्, n., Ved. protection, guardianship.
प्रावन् प्रावन् (fr. rt. 1. प्रा) in क्रतु-प्˚, q. v.

प्रावनिज् प्राव-निज् (प्र-अव-), cl. 3. P. A.
-नेनेक्ति, -नेनिक्ते, -नेक्तुम्, Ved. to wash away.

प्रावरेय प्रावरेय, अस्, m. a patronymic
from Pra-vara.
प्रावहणि प्रावहणि for प्रावाहणि, q. v.

प्रावासिक, अस्, ई, अम्, see Gaṇa Guḍādi to Pāṇ.
IV. 3, 103, and Gaṇa Santāpādi to Pāṇ. V. 1, 101.

प्रावाहणेयि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Prāvā-
haṇeya.

प्रावीण्य प्रावीण्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-वीण),
cleverness, dexterity, skilfulness, proficiency, accurate
knowledge, conversancy, skill.
प्रावरणीय, अम्, n. a covering, upper garment.

प्रावारिक, अस्, m. a maker of upper garments
or cloaks.

प्रावारीय, Nom. P. प्रावारीयति, -यितुम्, to
use as an upper garment or cloak.

प्रा-वुवूर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or intending
to wear.

प्रा-वृत्य, ind. having put on, having dressed
one's self in.

प्रावृत्तिक प्रावृत्तिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-
वृत्ति), secondary, derived, derivative, (opposed to
मुख्य); informed of what is passing, well-informed.
प्रा-वृष, अस्, आ, m. f. the rainy season, the rains.

प्रावृषायणी, f. (fr. प्रा-वृष्), a kind of
weed which grows most luxuriantly during the rains,
Bœrhavia Procumbens; Mucuna Pruritus.

प्रावृषिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the rainy
season, born or produced in the rainy season; (अस्),
m. a peacock (as delighting in the rains).

प्रावृषीण, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating
to the rainy season, rainy.

प्रावृषेण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating
to the rainy season; coming in showers, abundant,
numerous, much; (अस्), m. the Cadamba tree,
Nauclea Cadamba [cf. कदम्ब]; Wrightia Anti-
dysenterica; (आ), f. the plant Mucuna Pruritus; a
species of Punar-navā with red flowers.
प्रावृषेय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

प्रावृष्य, अस्, m. a species of Cadamba, Wrightia
Antidysenterica; Hedysarum Alhagi; (अम्), n. lapis
lazuli.

प्रावेण्य प्रावेण्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-वेणि or
प्र-वेणी), a fine woollen covering.

प्रावेशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वेश), relating to
entrance (into a house or upon the stage); connected
with entry; in the habit of entering; प्रावेशिक्य्
आक्षिप्तिका, a particular air or song called Ā-kṣiptikā
sung by a person on entering the stage.

प्र-वीविविक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, intending to pervade
or embrace.
